name: Vintage Rework

intent_defaults.description: A reuse-oriented design direction for adapting existing garments, deadstock, reclaimed panels and user-supplied vintage references.
intent_defaults.silhouette: User-selected vintage reference with adjustable modern proportions.

component_defaults.source: Record source garment or reclaimed material identity
component_defaults.panels: Prefer panel reuse where condition and geometry permit
component_defaults.repair: Visible or concealed repair as selected
component_defaults.fit: Adapt existing pattern and garment condition

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: Reuse suitability depends on the actual condition, dimensions and composition of the source garment.
Environmental benefit is not assumed; compare against a declared counterfactual and measured material flows.
